description: Standardized error messages for table and detail views per FR-008 and FR-019

timeout.title: Connection Timeout
timeout.message: The request took too long to complete. Please check your internet connection and try again.

offline.title: No Internet Connection
offline.message: You appear to be offline. Please check your internet connection and try again.

connectionRefused.title: Connection Failed
connectionRefused.message: Unable to connect to the server. Please try again in a moment.

dnsError.title: Server Not Found
dnsError.message: Unable to locate the server. Please check your connection and try again.

400.title: Invalid Request
400.message: The request was not understood by the server. Please refresh the page and try again.

401.title: Authentication Required
401.message: Your session has expired. Please log in again to continue.

403.title: Access Denied
403.message: You don't have permission to view this content. Please contact support if you believe this is an error.

404.title: Content Not Found
404.message: The requested content could not be found. It may have been removed or is no longer available.

429.title: Too Many Requests
429.message: You've made too many requests. Please wait a moment before trying again.

500.title: Server Error
500.message: The server encountered an error while processing your request. Please try again in a moment.

502.title: Server Unavailable
502.message: The server is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.

503.title: Service Unavailable
503.message: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.

504.title: Server Timeout
504.message: The server took too long to respond. Please try again.

emptyTable.title: No Results Found
emptyTable.message: No items match your current filters. Try adjusting your search criteria.

invalidData.title: Invalid Data
invalidData.message: The server returned unexpected data. Please try again or contact support if the issue persists.

partialData.title: Incomplete Data
partialData.message: Some information is missing or unavailable. Displaying what we have.

corruptedData.title: Data Error
corruptedData.message: The data appears to be corrupted or invalid. Please try refreshing the page.

sortFailure.title: Sorting Failed
sortFailure.message: Unable to sort the table. Please try a different sort option or refresh the page.

filterFailure.title: Filter Failed
filterFailure.message: Unable to apply filters. Please try again or refresh the page.

paginationFailure.title: Pagination Error
paginationFailure.message: Unable to load the requested page. Please try again.

loadFailure.title: Failed to Load Details
loadFailure.message: Unable to load complete details for this item. {errorDetail}

embeddedDataFailure.title: Related Data Unavailable
embeddedDataFailure.message: Some related information could not be loaded. The main content is displayed below.
embeddedDataFailure.technicalMessage: Embedded relationship data failed to load

tabLoadFailure.title: Tab Load Failed
tabLoadFailure.message: Unable to load this section. Please try again.

retryOrBack.label: Retry or Go Back
retryOrBack.description: Try again or return to list

notes.technicalMessage: Technical messages are for logging/debugging, not user display
notes.userAction: Determines which action button(s) to show with error
notes.consistency: All error messages follow Quasar notification standards
notes.accessibility: Error messages include ARIA live regions for screen readers
